title: Correct height difference
description: Essential: The student must correctly identify the vertical distance from A to C as h = l - OD = l - (2/3)l = (1/3)l.

title: Gravitational potential energy change
description: Essential: The final answer for the decrease in gravitational potential energy must be ΔE_p = - (1/3) mgl or equivalent.

title: Work done by gravity
description: Essential: The final answer for the work done by gravity must be W_G = (1/3) mgl.

title: Relationship between work and energy
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the relationship ΔE_p = -W_G for a conservative force.

title: Sign convention clarity
description: Important: The reasoning should clearly distinguish the decrease in potential energy (negative change) from the positive work done by gravity.

title: Irrelevance of intermediate path
description: Optional: The student may note that the work done by gravity is path-independent, depending only on the vertical displacement.

title: Incorrect height calculation
description: Pitfall: Using OD = (2/3)l as the height difference instead of l - OD.

title: Sign error in relationship
description: Pitfall: Stating ΔE_p = W_G instead of ΔE_p = -W_G, leading to a sign error in one answer.
